description: This file defines the OAuthAuthorizationService class responsible for managing OAuth2 provider interactions including authorization, token exchange, refresh, and session management within the SuiteCRM project. It interfaces with external OAuth providers such as Microsoft, Google, and a generic provider, enabling OAuth workflows and token management.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationService
classes.description: Service class providing OAuth2 provider management, token exchange, refresh, and session handling functionalities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: hasProvider
methods.description: Checks if a specific OAuth provider is available and properly configured.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves an external OAuth provider connector instance based on provider ID.

methods.name: authorizationRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the client to the OAuth provider's authorization URL for user authorization.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Obtains an access token from the OAuth provider using an authorization code.

methods.name: refreshConnectionToken
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth access token for a given connection record.

methods.name: hasConnectionTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the current OAuth token associated with a connection has expired.

methods.name: refreshExpiredOAuthToken
methods.description: Checks and refreshes the OAuth token if it has expired, given a connection ID.

methods.name: getOAuthRefreshTokenErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates error messages related to OAuth token refresh failures, optionally including a link to the connection edit page.

methods.name: mapToken
methods.description: Maps an OAuth access token into an array of token data suitable for storage.

methods.name: getProviderConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration array for a specific OAuth provider.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the global log object at specified severity levels.

methods.name: logResponse
methods.description: Logs details about exceptions encountered during token retrieval.

methods.name: getExternalOauthProvidersConnectors
methods.description: Returns an array of available external OAuth provider connector classes, with optional inclusion of custom connectors.
